protocol.memory_limit_note: address space cap applied to every solver process and to the native runner
protocol.timing: wall clock over the whole process; median of repetitions reported
protocol.determinism: single-threaded configurations; CP-SAT num_workers=1 with random_seed=1; minisat and kissat default deterministic configurations; no randomization flags otherwise

hardware.note: wall-clock timings are whole-process and include solver startup; machine is a shared two-core virtual machine

protocol.native_pipeline: native_dp_runner.py: load instance, tree-decomposition DP, certificate re-verification, policy reconstruction and verification, certificate emission; bounded by the same timeout and address-space cap
protocol.fe_accounting: FE preprocessing and certified relation generation are recorded separately from the recorded mechanics benchmark suite and excluded from both native and external timings
protocol.cross_check_discipline: external SAT models are verified natively as policies on the original instance; external UNSAT answers are cross-checked against verified DP-REFUTATION certificates; solver logs are not certificates
